Pixel · all rails

Amoji — Owner resource library (unified)

One place for Pixel to review ship-eligible resources. Every row has a master CD### plus a domain code (MV/ST/PH/NW/PK/ID/DC). Cite CD022 in chat for keep/remove. Rows highlighted In use match runtime defaults. Your pick fills from the same localStorage keys as the live app on this origin.

Local preview: cd docs && python3 -m http.server 8765 then open http://127.0.0.1:8765/owner-resources.html. GitHub Pages: https://monmonmars.github.io/amoji-app/docs/owner-resources.html.

Pixel — keep vs remove + per-row notes
  1. Every row is Keep by default (checked). Uncheck rows you want cut from the ship set.
  2. Type Usage note per row (music, VFX/CMA, voice/PK, movement/idle, demo PH, news NW, DC/MV/ST, etc.).
  3. Save notes JSON exports agent-ingestible file ({ cd, note, keep, … }) — uses showSaveFilePicker when available, else download. Backup: amoji.ownerPickerNotes.v1 on this origin.
  4. Copy JSON / Copy Markdown still export remove lists only (unchecked rows) — unchanged for engineers.
  5. Licensed / Hold rows are labeled honestly; uncheck means “don’t wire in app”, not “delete files” unless noted.

Default idle clip: IdleQuaterniusHuman.

Music & performance audio

Hold — no copyrighted commercial masters in catalog; Mixkit + CC0/PD only per docs/MUSIC_STREAMING.md. Stripe / licensed spike #1 remains Hold elsewhere.

Runtime owner perf prefs: amoji.ownerPerfPicks.v1 (listenMvCodes, songClipIds) — ship-set apps/web/data/owner-perf-selection.json. Checked MV stream rows → copy codes into that JSON; idle dance/sing body still uses amoji.idlePick.v6 / amoji.idleEnabled.v6.

Owner codes: DC### performance files · MV039–MV118 Mixkit streams (registry owner-catalog-registry.ts).

Owner idle prefs (same keys as CompanionCanvas / idle-pick.ts): amoji.idlePick.v6 (per-character VRMA pin map — apps/web/lib/idle-owner-migrate.ts:20), amoji.idleEnabled.v6 (curated rail #s ON for rotation). Legacy amoji.idlePick.v1…v5 migrate forward — never wiped (#432). Fresh default enable rails: #10 → IdleQuaterniusHuman. Known-bad pins (BreathCalm, Sassy, LookAround, …) scrub on read — see idle-owner-migrate.ts.

Your saved picks column highlights rows when this browser’s localStorage already has your pins or enabled rails (open from the same origin as the app, e.g. GitHub Pages, after you have used Amoji on that device).

Blend rule: A→B crossfades only within the same idleClipFamily (Quaternius / RPM / Mixamo / Innerscene / lib_C*). Mixed-family swaps use a short cut (IDLE_INCOMPAT_CROSSFADE_S). CompanionCanvas sets singleIdleStand to reduce bad A→B blends on phone.
